title: 10 Share and Collaboration
subtitle: One Share button, people and AI on the same canvas, comments, sync in words — Alligators brand at full complexity

artboards.label: 1 · Share — Invite is the first thing
artboards.note: Share opens on Invite: an email, a role in words, Invite; Petra's pending invite shows its expiry and Resend; the project's team row is read-only here; Copy link second; This canvas or Whole project first; the Share cluster carries Edit · Preview · Present.

artboards.label: 2 · Roles in words — one canvas or the whole project
artboards.note: The role menu says what each role lets you do, with one trash rule (editors move to the trash, owners clear it out); downloads start at Can comment, Can view is look only; one shared canvas shows alone with no New canvas; the whole project brings all 93.

artboards.label: 3 · A link, opened in a browser
artboards.note: Vojta has no app: the link opens Combine-kampan live on cloud.maude.sh in Preview — cursors and pins, no toolbar; Viewing is one click away; Ask to edit is the way to more; Open in the Mac app is one quiet button.

artboards.label: 4 · Faces, cursors and two AIs
artboards.note: Three faces then +4; people wear soft colours, only AI wears the spark; Tereza's face menu offers Follow, Go to and Bring everyone here.

artboards.label: 5 · Following Tereza
artboards.note: Following Tereza: a thin frame in her colour and one pill with esc; her selection is drawn in her colour; esc, a scroll or a click stops it.

artboards.label: 6 · Bring everyone here — the moment
artboards.note: The signature moment as a 3-frame filmstrip: you ask (⌘K or any face), every cursor glides to you on its own curve with a dotted wake in its colour while your frame draws in, then they land with a small spring. Motion spec + reduced-motion fallback.

artboards.label: 7 · Everyone's here
artboards.note: The end of the glide at full size: a frame in your colour, a pill with Stop; each person can leave with esc.

artboards.label: 8 · A thread, a mention, Resolve
artboards.note: A thread on A4 · plakát with Resolve; @ suggests people with their role; the Comments panel filters Open / Mine / Resolved.

artboards.label: 9 · When someone mentions you
artboards.note: A mention reaches you once: a toast with Open, a Mac notification + Dock count in the background, an e-mail from cloud.maude.sh with Open in the Mac app when the app is closed.

artboards.label: 10 · A comment on a video frame
artboards.note: A pin on Reels · nábor at 0:12 shows only at that moment; the timeline carries one marker per thread.

artboards.label: 11 · A comment on a print artboard
artboards.note: A comment on the A6 flyer speaks millimetres; print guides show the trim and safe margin it is about.

artboards.label: 12 · A day offline on Alligators brand
artboards.note: A day offline: everything works and stays on this Mac; unsent canvases say “not sent”, the panel foot counts; a comment is Queued — sends when this Mac is online; invites wait too.

artboards.label: 13 · Back online — 14 changes go up
artboards.note: Back online: Syncing…, the panel foot counts; Tereza's overnight change arrives with her name; the conflicted sticky wears a “2 versions” mark; one toast with Show.

artboards.label: 14 · You and Jonas changed the same sticky
artboards.note: Both versions side by side with who/when/where: Keep yours, Keep Jonas's or Keep both; Version history shows both with Restore — nothing lost, visibly.

artboards.label: 15 · Moved to the trash while you had it open
artboards.note: Tereza (Can edit) moved Combine-cisla to the trash while you had it open: you can keep looking, changes stay with it, Restore is the one action; only an owner clears out the trash.

artboards.label: 16 · Local project — Share moves it to the cloud
artboards.note: Step for step as 02 Onboarding: the Move to cloud offer, the browser sign-in only if needed, then Share opens on Invite while canvases go up (Syncing…, toast).

artboards.label: 17 · Twelve people on one canvas
artboards.note: Twelve people: three faces and +8, a people list with where each one is, idle cursors turn grey and shrink to an initial, Bring everyone here at its foot.

artboards.label: 18 · Can view, trying to change something
artboards.note: Petra can view: Viewing in the mode switch, no toolbar, her drag explains itself; Ask to edit sends one request that waits at the top of the owner's Share — Let Petra edit / Not now.

artboards.label: 19 · Access ends, gently
artboards.note: Removing Lukáš asks once; his open canvas dims behind one sentence + Back to Home; a link turned off shows a viewer the same calm card.

artboards.label: 20 · Share › Advanced — link rules, other ways in, where it syncs
artboards.note: Share › Advanced, row for row as 06 Advanced (link rules, App link, This Mac only, GitHub invite, Hub, Last synced); the roles matrix with the trash rule; a self-hosted hub with only the roles it supports.
